result.summary: The page layout is mostly consistent, but there is one visible styling inconsistency with the heart/favorite icon styling between cards.

issues.description: The heart/favorite icon on the Tokumaru Ramen Bar card has a white circular background, while the same icon on the pizza promo card below has a dark/black circular background, creating inconsistent visual styling between similar card elements.
issues.suggestion: Standardize the heart icon background style (color and opacity) across all restaurant/promo cards for visual consistency.
